audience: Tactical watchstanders and reviewing analysts exploring fictional contact evidence locally.
primaryTask: Enter Name, IMO or MMSI, resolve identity, inspect evidence and export a cited draft for human interpretation.
successOutcome: A concise 1-page intelligence brief exposes all five named source families, every factual citation and timestamp, conflicts and UNKNOWN values, and downloads with synthetic provenance.

screens.name: Contact research
screens.purpose: Labeled identifier type/value and optional name constraint; explicit Research contact action. Example values are labeled synthetic. Desktop query rail and brief workspace; stacked narrow layout.

screens.name: Identity review
screens.purpose: Show distinct name, IMO and MMSI for each candidate; no merged result or preselected candidate.

screens.name: Brief and source inspection
screens.purpose: Readable one-page draft with claim links opening exact highlighted source spans, metadata, source revision digest and timestamps. Secondary diagnostics and provenance; deliberate export for human review.

states.empty: Explain Name/IMO/MMSI search, show synthetic scope and examples; no fabricated result or enabled export.
states.loading: Announce Researching local synthetic evidence in a live status region, disable duplicate submit/export, clear previous result validity; no artificial delay.
states.error: Specific input, identity conflict, no-match, service-unavailable or evidence-integrity message preserves query. Hide previous brief/export so it cannot be mistaken for current output.
states.success: Show resolved identity, source-specific findings, owner conflict with both values and citations, historical/missing warnings and UNKNOWN. Export enabled only for resolved current result; no approval or operational recommendation.

persistence: Session-only query and selection survive opening/closing source/provenance panels. Reload clears the draft with an explicit session-only notice. No approval/save state is implied; export is the durable review boundary. New query clears previous candidate selection and result.
recovery: Correct invalid identifier/name constraint without data loss. Choose ambiguous candidate explicitly. Secondary diagnostics mutate an isolated in-memory copy only; Restore synthetic corpus discards that copy, preserving query. Service errors explain restart/retry. Closing the app/server is shutdown; no background monitoring or external actions.
keyboard: Native labels/selects/buttons, Enter submits query, logical Tab order and visible focus. Dialog Escape/Close returns focus to citation. Status and validation announced. Minimum 44px action targets, text and state labels with contrast, no color-only warnings; reduced motion. Narrow screens stack panels with wrapped long citations and no page-wide overflow. Print/export use US Letter portrait and retain citations/warnings; source detail appendices are screen-only.
